newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-April approved projects up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-April approved projects up sharply.

text.p: The Philippine Board of Investments said on Sunday the value of approved projects for the first four months leapt 108 percent to 145.44 billion pesos.

The projects, representing potential investments in the medium term, would be given fiscal incentives such as income tax holidays and the minimum three percent duty on imported capital equipment, it said.
The agency said 123 new and expansion projects were approved during the period, of which 58 were major projects, accounting for 89 percent of the total project cost.
The big projects include two road projects worth 40.53 billion pesos, power projects amounting to 51.38 billion pesos and a cement plant costing 6.52 billion pesos.
